chunks: God has decreed: "I will prevail, I and My apostles." Verily God is powerful and all-mighty.
ai.seo_question: What does God decree regarding the victory of Him and His messengers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a guarantee of ultimate victory for the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful, linking divine omnipotence to the triumph of justice over tyranny. It serves as a source of comfort for believers, affirming that God's promise to His messengers is irrevocable and rooted in His absolute strength.
